budget_items.topic: Memorial Day cemetery flowers and grounds work with Lake View
budget_items.what_was_said: A member noted the commission had previously approved flowers for the cemetery and work with Lake View, not to exceed a set amount, and asked whether to cover it now since there would be no meeting before Memorial Day. It was agreed the department of correction contact (Bill Bernardi) would cover the spring work since it wasn't on this meeting's agenda, with the commission taking it up formally for the fall.
It was noted the Department of Correction, via Bill Bernardi, would do weed whacking and cleanup before Memorial Day, and that DPW had covered it themselves in prior years.

decisions.decision: Bill Bernardi/department of correction will cover the spring Memorial Day cemetery flowers and cleanup since it was not on this meeting's agenda; the commission will formally take it up for the fall and thereafter.

The commission leaned toward holding future meetings at the library (which has a Zoom-equipped conference room) rather than continuing to bring a town computer, pending the chair checking availability.
Future meetings will start around 6:00 PM rather than daytime, to accommodate members' work schedules.
The chair will check with the library whether the third or fourth Thursday of the month works and notify members by phone (since not all have email on file).
